meta.title: Grow a Garden pet mutations data

sources.label: Grow a Garden Wiki - Pet Mutations

items.name: Shiny
items.passive: Provides an additional 15% boost to the pet's XP per second!

items.name: Inverted
items.passive: Provides an additional 30% boost to the pet's XP per second!

items.name: Frozen
items.passive: Every 5:00-0:30m, 20-30% chance a nearby fruit becomes Frozen!

items.name: Windy
items.passive: Every 5:00-0:30m, 20-30% chance a nearby fruit becomes Windstruck!

items.name: Golden
items.passive: Provides a big increase to the pet's passive!

items.name: Mega
items.passive: Pet is gigantic! Has 20% faster hunger rate. Gains an additional 10-40 xp per second!

items.name: Tiny
items.passive: Pet is very tiny! Has 20% slower hunger rate. Gains an additional 5-30 xp per second!

items.name: IronSkin
items.passive: When another player steals fruit from you, grants a 35-45% chance you get the stolen fruit as well!

items.name: Radiant
items.passive: Every 30:00-20:00m, emits sunshine at a random nearby plant and advances their growth by 24 hours!

items.name: Rainbow
items.passive: Provides a massive increase to the pet's passive!

items.name: Shocked
items.passive: During a Thunderstorm: Every 60-45s, has a 25-30% chance to attract lightning, shocking nearby fruits!

items.name: Ascended
items.passive: Every 360:21-300:00m (6-5 hours), a nearby fruit ascends to a higher realm, with a 75-90% chance to apply the Dawnbound mutation!

items.name: Tranquil
items.passive: Every 25:00-16:40m, a nearby fruit finds inner peace, with a 20-30% chance to apply the Tranquil mutation!

items.name: Corrupted
items.passive: Every 25:00-16:40m, a nearby fruit embraces the corruption, with a 20-30% chance to apply the Corrupted mutation!

items.name: Fried
items.passive: Every 16:40-8:20m, a nearby fruit is sizzled up, with a 40-60% chance to apply the Fried mutation!
items.chance: N/A

items.name: Aromatic
items.passive: Every 25:00-16:40m, a nearby fruit is infused with a pungent aroma, with a 20-30% chance to apply the Aromatic mutation!
items.chance: N/A

items.name: GiantBean
items.passive: Pet is a GIANT BEAN! Has 15% faster hunger rate. Gains an additional 0.1-0.5xp/s for each Beanstalk planted in your garden!
items.chance: Crafted during Beanstalk event using 3 beanstalks and 1 cleansing pet shard

items.name: Silver
items.passive: Provides a small increase to the pet's passive!
items.chance: Achievements

items.name: Glimmering
items.passive: Every 25:00-13:20m, a nearby fruit is sprinkled with fairy dust, with a 20-30% chance to apply the Glimmering mutation!
items.chance: 1.72% on tier 3 of fountain rewards 3.03% on tier 4 of fountain rewards 5.88% on tier 5 of fountain rewards

items.name: Luminous
items.passive: Every 33:20-16:40m, a nearby fruit is imbued with fairy power, with a 20-30% chance to apply the Luminous mutation!
items.chance: Guaranteed reward in the form of a Mutation Shard from the Fairy Event's mini achievements section. Obtained upon completion.

items.name: Nutty
items.passive: Every 20:00-2:00 minutes, the pet's next ability use has a 20-40% chance to activate twice. Otherwise, this pet loses a level.
items.chance: 0.24% chance from collecting acorns from Chubby Chipmunk.

items.name: Dreadbound
items.passive: Gains an additional 6.5-30 xp per second!
items.chance: Chance to be applied by the Headless Horseman.

items.name: Soulflame
items.passive: Provides an additional 60% boost to the pet's xp per second. Every 15:12-5:00m, a nearby fruit has a 20-30% chance to get mutated with Burnt - lower chance for Flaming!
items.chance: Chance to be applied by the Headless Horseman.

items.name: Spectral
items.passive: Provides a small increase to the pet's passive!
items.chance: Chance to be applied by the Headless Horseman.

items.name: Nightmare
items.passive: Provides a bigger increase to the pet's passive and is slightly bigger!
items.chance: Rare chance to be applied by the Headless Horseman.

items.name: Tethered
items.passive: Constantly wanders around the player!
items.chance: Toffee Tether

items.name: Aurora
items.passive: Every 42:05-16:40m, 3-50% chance a nearby fruit becomes Aurora!

items.name: Jumbo
items.passive: Pet is Jumbo and gains +50% XP BOOST! All nearby plants within 14.75-35 studs will have an increased 0.004-0.01x size bonus for every Safari-type plant planted in your garden! (max 300)
items.chance: Safari Shop

items.name: Oxpecker
items.passive: When Safari type pets finish their abilities, they start their cooldown with 7.5-3.5 seconds less! Gains tiny increase to passives!
items.chance: 2.44% chance from giving a pet to Safari Joe

items.name: Giraffe
items.passive: Every 25:54-9:43m, eats fruit that are atleast 10 studs high for 0.36-0.75x sell value. The plant the fruit came from advances growth by 30:00-16:37m! Also applies Arid mutation to all other fruits on that plant. Gains small increase to passives!
items.chance: 2.04% chance from giving a pet to Safari Joe

items.name: Rhino
items.passive: Every 25:54-12:57m, charges into a random egg or random fruit in your garden: Rammed eggs have hatch time halved, rammed fruits get Mirage mutation! Cannot be mimicked or refreshed. Gains medium increase to passives!
items.chance: 0.75-4.12% chance from giving a pet to Safari Joe

items.name: Crocodile
items.passive: Every 35:00-17:30m, bites on to a random Plant or Pet for 7.5-12.5s and performs a roll. Plants grow an additional 22.5-11.25s/s and Pets get additional 16.25-8.75 XP/s. Gains sizable increase to passives!
items.chance: 0.76-2.06% chance from giving a pet to Safari Joe

items.name: Lion
items.passive: Every 23:20-5:50m, roars and calls all pets in your garden to move toward it. 100-200 total cooldown advancement is shared across each pet (max 30-15 seconds per pet). Gains big increase to passives!
items.chance: 0.55-1.03% chance from giving a pet to Safari Joe

items.name: Forger
items.passive: Every 13:20-6:40m goes to an active crafting table and advances its crafting time by 40-80s!
items.chance: Can be crafted as a Pet Mutation Shard in the smithing event, the materials required are: Gem Egg Legendary Coal Cleansing Pet Shard 4,500,000

items.name: Nocturnal
items.passive: Every 23:34-11:40m, a random fruit gets advanced by 12h! Cooldown ticks down twice as fast during the night!
items.chance: 0.5% Chance from the Christmas Present

items.name: Peppermint
items.passive: Every 16:06-8:20m, sacrifices 12 random Christmas-type fruit in your garden to instantly activate this pet's ability!
items.chance: 10% chance from Peppermint Vine when hatching a pet in the plant's radius

items.name: Spirit Sparkle
items.passive: Every 25:00-20:00m, your pet either ages up once, or ages down once.
items.chance: 10% chance from Spirit Sparkle when hatching a pet in the plant's radius

items.name: Christmas Rally
items.passive: All Christmas-themed pets gain an additional 3.5-7.5XP per second!
items.chance: From the Ice Golem pet!

items.name: Jolly Decorator
items.passive: Every 8:25-4:10m, applies Ornamented mutation to a random fruit!
items.chance: From the Ice Golem pet!

items.name: Merry Nursery
items.passive: Every 30:00-5:00m, goes to the unhatched egg with the highest hatch time and reduces it by 25-60s with a bonus 1-2s for every Christmas-type plant in your garden!
items.chance: From the Ice Golem pet!

items.name: GiantGolem
items.passive: Pet is a giant golem! Has a big increase to passive, slightly bigger & gains bonus 0.015XP/s for every Christmas-type plant in your garden!
items.chance: Rare chance from the Ice Golem pet!

items.name: HyperHunger
items.passive: BIG boost to passive but hunger drains SUPER DUPER FAST! Boost is disabled when hunger is less than 25%.
items.chance: Santa's Stash

items.name: Venom
items.passive: BIG boost to passive but drains 0.02 xp per second!
items.chance: 5 ~ 10% chance from the Giant Scorpion pet!

items.name: Fiery
items.passive: Every 10:00-5:00m, consumes a random fruit to mutate fruits around it with the Fiery mutation!
items.chance: TBA

items.name: UFO
items.passive: Provides a big boost to the pet's passive!
items.chance: N/A

items.name: Alienated
items.passive: Grants small increase to passive, but drains ~0.07% XP/s!
items.chance: A chance to obtain from the Alien Chaos Weather!

items.name: Blossoming
items.passive: Provides a bigger increase to the pet's passive, and gains an additional 7-25 XP/s!
items.chance: TBA% chance from Elder Candy Blossom when hatching a pet in the plant's radius!
